title: A caption that slides up
summary: overflow: hidden plus a translated caption: on hover the caption slides in and the image zooms slightly.
explanation: The caption is absolutely positioned at the bottom of the card and pushed down by its own height with translateY(100%). overflow: hidden on the card clips it, so at rest it is out of sight. Hovering the card sets translateY(0) and the transition slides it in.
The selector is .card:hover .caption: hovering the parent changes the child. The image scales a little at the same time, and overflow: hidden keeps the zoom inside the rounded corners.
Hover does not exist on touch screens, so information that only appears on hover is lost there. :focus-within on the card shows it to keyboard users, but for important text keep it visible.
tryThis: Remove overflow: hidden from .card: the hidden caption shows below the card and the zoomed image spills out.
Swap the slide for a fade: give .caption opacity: 0 instead of the transform, opacity: 1 on hover, and transition opacity instead of transform.
